newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 473.8 mln reais in Treasury notes. [CORRECTED 19:48 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 473.8 mln reais in Treasury notes. [CORRECTED 19:48 GMT]

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank, on behalf of the National Treasury, raised 473.8 (corrects from 547.4) million reais in an extraordinary auction of Treasury notes indexed to the fluctuations of the dollar, dealers said.
The notes, called NTN-D, will mature on May 1, 1997 and will pay annual yields of 13.52 percent, dealers said.
Analysts said the auction, which is usually set at the end of the month, was a move to calm fears the government will speed up the real's depreciation to lower Brazil's trade gap.
But Central Bank chief Gustavo Loyola denied this, saying the auction was set so the government could take advantage of "market conditions."
